eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to book physiotherapy.
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Mario Garcia Lopez. My DNI is39••••38
Ficha encontrada: Mario G. (por DNI y nombre)
Sin huecos en fisioterapia · frenados por regla: D. Álvaro Cid (hace falta volante)
Regla de la casa: hace falta volante
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. I'm sorry, I can't book that: that specialty needs a referral, and there isn't one on the record. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
